commands:
set -eu
base=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
cd "$wt"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 91334a76de1e8d239c68dff9c29002847a6c5097
printf 'DEP_SIZES_BEGIN\n'
du -sh "$base/frontend/node_modules" "$base/backend/.venv"
printf 'DEP_SIZES_END\n'
printf 'GIT_STATUS_BEFORE\n'
git status --short
printf 'DATA_COUNTS\n'
"$wt/backend/.venv/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
db=sqlite3.connect('file:backend/data/app.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
tables={x[0] for x in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")}
for name in ('place','places','photo','photos','memory','memories'):
 if name in tables: print(name, db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM "'+name+'"').fetchone()[0])
print("SQLITE_INTEGRITY",db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0])
PY
printf 'TRACKPAD_UNIT_TESTS\n'
cd frontend
npm run test -- src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts
printf 'FRONTEND_BUILD\n'
npm run build
printf 'PRETTIER_CHANGED_FILES\n'
./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
printf 'GIT_STATUS_AFTER\n'
cd "$wt"
git status --short
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_ZOOM_VERIFY_BUILD_COMPLETE
